description: Ping that creates its own monitor on the first hit. Same slug = same monitor; 402 when the free tier is full, and then nothing is written. The slug becomes the monitor name and its identity: the same slug always means the same monitor, so a retry never creates a second one. Normalised to lowercase, `[a-z0-9-]`, 40 chars. Creation happens **only inside the free tier** (or the trial); past it the ping is a 402 with `accepts[]` and nothing is written — not even the event. Works by GET or POST.

slug.description: Name of the job; it becomes the monitor name.
